resolve_ipv4.description: If true, restricts resolution to IPv4 addresses (-4).

resolve_ipv6.description: If true, restricts resolution to IPv6 addresses (-6).

show_client.description: If true, shows client SRV records (-c).

show_server.description: If true, shows server SRV records (-s).

check_fallback.description: If true, checks fallback ports on A/AAAA records if no SRV records are provided (-f).

test_connection.description: If true, tests the connection and certificates (-t).

resolve_ips.description: If true, resolves and displays IP addresses (-v).

domains.description: List of XMPP domain names to check for SRV records. These are positional arguments passed to the CLI.
